setting: You are all in Karachi, Pakistan, in your own homes and offices across the city, texting one another as old university housemates who shared a rented house during your student years.
openers: Send a photo of the old house gate
Ask who is free for dinner Friday
Share a link to an old housemate's new article
Suggest a catch-up call this weekend

private_lines.Usman: You live in Karachi, Pakistan, where your days are filled with journalism work, and you live with nobody else in your home.

text: [photo: the old house gate]
Passing by on the way to a press thing. They painted it
Which colour
Some green. Not the old green
Thats a crime
Is that the street 9 gate? The one that always stuck
Yes. Still sticks. They just painted over the lock
We used to lift it and push
Nadia remember the night usman locked himself out with the milk
He locked himself out because he was taking milk from the neighbours
I was not stealing. I was borrowing with intent
Never returned it
The neighbours still bring it up
Sample run went late. 4 hours on a column that wasnt even ours. Back at the lab now
Anyway. Who has the old house key
Not me. I gave it to the landlord the day we left. Or I think I did
He said the lock was getting changed anyway
In doha, 40 mins on the ground. Nobody has the key. Thats the house's problem now
Usman ask the landlord for a photo of the new lock
He doesn't reply to me. He never replied to anyone
He replied to me once about the deposit. Took 3 years
Cant believe we paid that rent
2011 rent. 14000 a month for that room with the fan that only worked on one setting
It was 9000. You're remembering wrong
It was 14000 and you paid late every month
I paid late twice
Guys I'm going to be stuck here. The centrifuge alarm is going off and nobody's answering the facilities line
Ok it stopped. I'm fine
[photo: the press room at 8pm, nobody here but me and a kettle]
The copy desk left early. Not on strike, just left
Landed. Checking into the hotel. Crew wants to get food. I'm too tired for food
Ok I'll eat
Home. Eating dal from the tiffin. You would not believe the day
The tiffin is from the aunty downstairs, she sends it every tuesday
Send her my regards
Did the gate ever get fixed
No. We all just knew to lift it
Right
Tell the gate I said hi
Did the gate say anything
Still in Doha. Return delayed. Nobody has the key still
Called the landlord. Went to voicemail. Obviously
Did you leave a message or just breathe into it
Left a message. Said I'm the one who gave him the key and he should reply to a human
Good. Most useful thing anyone's done about that gate in 15 years
[photo: a note taped to the press room kettle, "NOT YOURS"]
Someone is clearly having a worse day than me
Lab is back on. Column rerun Friday. Nobody wants to be here on a Wednesday
Found the 2011 receipts. Mum kept everything
[photo: rent receipt, 2011, Rs 9,000, paid on the 3rd]
Paid on the 3rd. Late
Once
You said twice
I'm not discussing this from a hotel
Can someone confirm which fan setting worked
Back in Karachi. Crew took the cab. Supposed to be in bed by 10, not happening
Home. Dal again. Aunty says it's the last one, she's going to her daughter's in Lahore for a month
So that's my tuesdays
Ask her to leave the recipe
Ok I'm going to sleep. Gate's still there if anyone wants to lift it
Landlord called back. Says the lock was changed in March. Has no photo
Asked me if I was "the one who always lifted the gate". How does he know that
Everyone knew about the gate. Nobody ever fixed it
Lahore sector. Coffee is bad here. Not that anyone asked
The fan was the one on the left. Right one died after the storm
That's not an answer
Left side. Nobody remembers the right side
Lab column rerun moved to Monday. Friday's cancelled
Ok I'm complaining
[photo: a desk covered in old printouts, a torn green sticky note on top]
Found my copy of the house inventory from the day we moved in. Fan listed as "works, one speed"
That's not the same as 14000
It's the same as one speed
Doha again tomorrow, then Jeddah. Someone tell the gate I'm still thinking about it
Home. Aunty came up with the last tiffin. Plus a jar of her chutney
She asked if the three of us are still in touch. I said yes, mostly about a gate
Tell her the gate is most of our conversation
Did she give the recipe
She said she'd write it down. Then she said her handwriting is terrible. Then she said Lahore
[photo: the press room kettle with the NOT YOURS note still taped to it]
Someone has written underneath it. "YOURS ALSO"
Landlord just texted. Two words. "Lock: yes."
Crew bus. Layover in an hour. Going to try for sleep
Going to bed. Lab tomorrow before 9 because the cooler's down
Can't sleep. Crew snoring through the wall. Did anyone ever get the gate photo
